svg.title: Allocate $8,000–$35,000 Without Buying Claim Principal
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate $8,000–$35,000 Without Buying Claim Principal; subtitle: Four buckets; illustrative Base launch allocation totals $20,000.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values encode the $20,000 Base launch plan. Each bucket also states a lean and expanded allocation; lean allocations sum to $8,000 and expanded allocations sum to $35,000. These are startup capital allocations, not annual revenue scenarios or additional waterfall expenses. Reconcile actual spending to the expense ledger to avoid counting the same cost twice. Substantial surety collateral is outside these budgets; choose standard payment if accelerated payment cannot fit verified capital capacity.; caption: Lean: $1,000 + $2,000 + $3,000 + $2,000 = $8,000. Base launch: $20,000. Expanded: $4,000 + $9,000 + $14,000 + $8,000 = $35,000.; stages: label: Entity and risk setup; value: $2,500 Base; $1,000 lean; $4,000 expanded; numeric value: 2500.0; detail: Fund entity setup, contract preparation, insurance deposits, and authority documentation. Keep client recovery agreements separate from broker Powers of Attorney and settlement administrator authorization forms.; label: Secure evidence tooling; value: $5,000 Base; $2,000 lean; $9,000 expanded; numeric value: 5000.0; detail: Fund initial manifest intelligence, encrypted storage, reconciliation scripts, access controls, and audit logging. Purchase only the data coverage needed for the first authorized cohort instead of broad speculative datasets.; label: Specialist launch capacity; value: $8,000 Base; $3,000 lean; $14,000 expanded; numeric value: 8000.0; detail: Reserve broker, analyst, and counsel capacity for initial eligibility work and sample packets. Obtain written scopes and fee schedules before accepting labor-intensive cases with uncertain records or fragile deadlines.; label: Working-capital reserve; value: $4,500 Base; $2,000 lean; $8,000 expanded; numeric value: 4500.0; detail: Hold cash for evidence retrieval, recurring overhead, and collection delays. At $1,500 monthly spend, the Base reserve covers three months; at $9,500, less than one month. Throttle intake when expected payment timing exceeds runway.

rect.title: label: Entity and risk setup; numeric value: 2500.0; value: $2,500 Base; $1,000 lean; $4,000 expanded; detail: Fund entity setup, contract preparation, insurance deposits, and authority documentation. Keep client recovery agreements separate from broker Powers of Attorney and settlement administrator authorization forms.

At $1,500 monthly spend, the Base reserve covers three months; at $9,500, less than one month. Throttle intake when expected payment timing exceeds runway.

text.title: Assumptions: Numeric values encode the $20,000 Base launch plan. Each bucket also states a lean and expanded allocation; lean allocations sum to $8,000 and expanded allocations sum to $35,000. These are startup capital allocations, not annual revenue scenarios or additional waterfall expenses. Reconcile actual spending to the expense ledger to avoid counting the same cost twice. Substantial surety collateral is outside these budgets; choose standard payment if accelerated payment cannot fit verified capital capacity.
